avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces alprazolam levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; both hepatotoxic

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression leading to excessive sedation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only with physician supervision and dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depressant effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation; maintain moderate supplemental doses

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel patient on increased drowsiness risk

caution_supplements.name: Chamomile
caution_supplements.action: Limit use; monitor for excessive sedation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases alprazolam levels and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and juice entirely during treatment

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; synergistic impairment of cognition and motor function
caution_foods.action: Minimize or eliminate alcohol; counsel on severe impairment risk

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay alprazolam absorption slightly; minimal clinical impact
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food for predictability

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and CNS depression, particularly when combined with other CNS depressants or CYP3A4 inhibitors. Assess for substance use disorder risk and dependence development, especially with concurrent alcohol use.
